query: INSERT INTO tache (id, nature, sujet, cabinet_cible, dossier_cible, etat, cree_le, prochaine_tentative) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'notification', 'retard_horodatage', cabinet_cible, dossier_cible, 'en_attente', $2, $2 FROM tache WHERE nature = 'horodatage' AND etat <> 'terminee' AND cree_le <= $1 GROUP BY cabinet_cible, dossier_cible ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING cabinet_cible, dossier_cible AS "dossier_cible!"
